context: Riku-teen helps Hina-young carry her heavy school books.
purpose: Older teen offering practical help to younger.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Riku, these books are so heavy!
lines.style: Bright, unselfconscious call across a short distance. Genuine strain on the words 'heavy' — not exaggerating, just stating the obvious fact. Quick, unguarded.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Immediate offer, no hesitation. Warm and easy — this is what you do for someone. Light upturn at the end, like rolling up sleeves.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Genuine relief in the breath. Grateful but not over-the-top. Soft landing on the final word, like she's already feeling lighter.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: You carry this much every single day?
lines.style: Slight disbelief. Warm concern underneath. The question lands with gentle weight — not mocking, actually noticing. A beat of pause before the question.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Yeah, there's a lot to study for.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact acceptance tinged with quiet tiredness. Not complaining, just stating how things are. Slight exhale woven into the middle of the sentence.
